science_relevance.scientific_problem: Bound Erdős' minimum-overlap constant for a set and translations of its complement.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Determining this extremal constant advances a named problem in combinatorial number theory and analysis. The task seeks explicit feasible constructions relevant to its upper bound.

papers.title: Erdős' minimum overlap problem
papers.task_relation: White develops a stronger lower bound for the same minimum-overlap constant. The local task instead searches bounded step-function constructions yielding upper bounds; both address the constant itself, and this paper is not claimed to supply the local construction.
papers.primary_goal: Improve rigorous bounds on Erdős' minimum-overlap problem.

science_relevance.reason: Primary research addresses the underlying problem directly; scientific importance does not rely on the agent/framework paper.
